problem_text:
A logistics manager must select packages to load onto a cargo drone. Available packages are:
* Package A: size 11 cubic feet, revenue $96
* Package B: size 22 cubic feet, revenue $252
* Package C: size 27 cubic feet, revenue $91
* Package D: size 38 cubic feet, revenue $155
* Package E: size 49 cubic feet, revenue $267
* Package F: size 8 cubic feet, revenue $198
* Package G: size 23 cubic feet, revenue $83
* Package H: size 41 cubic feet, revenue $193
* Package I: size 50 cubic feet, revenue $252
* Package J: size 41 cubic feet, revenue $275
* Package K: size 49 cubic feet, revenue $37
* Package L: size 13 cubic feet, revenue $141
* Package M: size 12 cubic feet, revenue $176
* Package N: size 19 cubic feet, revenue $204
The drone's cargo hold has a maximum capacity of 282 cubic feet. Choose the package combination that yields the highest total revenue without exceeding this capacity. Each package must be either fully loaded or left behind.
